Question: I was given a ID No.7446 few months ago. I still have not received any reply. Again I'm repeating my question. A couple of month ago WHEN I WAS SLEEPIN IN THE MORNING after ISHRAQ PRAYER. I HAD A DREAM IN WIHICH ONE MY FREINDS IS SAYING TOTAL AZAN IN MY LEFT EAR. Answer ID: 8586 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1844/1766=D/1429) If you have heard the azan in months other than the months of hajj (Shawwal, Dhul Qadah and Dhul Hijj), then in-shaAllah with the blessing of good deeds and due to following the sunnah you shall gain strength and stability in Eiman . Therefore, you should keep on doing good deeds and follow the sunnah with much interest. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
